description: Auto-merge an agentcfg patch or minor bump once CI passes. A minor adds a fragment, an axis value or a rule and is additive, so nothing an agent was already doing becomes wrong, but it does mean rules arrive without anyone reading them — choose this where the repository trusts the central rules and would rather not gate on review. Majors still wait: the base preset holds every major behind the Dependency Dashboard. Extend this beside the base preset in a repository's renovate.json.
